the development of an AD mouse model with a more rapid progression of AD-related pathology than the APP/PS 1 model, which may be of great interest in the development of new drugs and therapeutic approaches for the treatment of AD.

this new mouse model is an interesting and useful tool to study early AD pathology and its progression in the presence of a senescent brain.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
SAMP8 background exacerbates the amyloid and tau pathologies, but the cognitive dysfunction remains similar to the APP/PS 1 mice.
APP/PS 1 transgenic mouse in a senescent background is a good model to study the early onset of AD pathology, but not to mimic AD-like cognitive deficits.
